info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Update Correspondent Bank Directory API
info.description: This API enables clients to update details in the Correspondent Bank Directory, which serves as a vital resource for financial institutions seeking to manage and maintain their international banking relationships. By utilizing this endpoint, users can modify existing bank entries, ensuring that their directory reflects accurate and up-to-date information. Typical consumers of this API include banking institutions, financial service providers, and compliance teams that rely on precise banking data for efficient operations. This facility streamlines banking operations and enhances collaboration in global finance.

put.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specific correspondent bank entry identified by RES-100045 in the external agency's bank directory. Ensure that you provide all necessary details in the request body to successfully complete the update.

requestBody.description: This request body allows you to update the correspondent bank information in the bank directory with the specified resource ID. Please ensure that you include all required fields as defined in the schema.

200.description: The request was successfully processed and the resource has been updated.
